title: gateway.health_changed.v1
description: The health state of a (gateway, operation) pair changed in one region. Published by Gateway Registry & Integration (BC-4) on pp.gateways.health.v1, keyed by gateway_id, on a COMPACTED topic so a restarting router learns the current state of every gateway in one read. This is the feedback loop from the Observability plane back into Control. It is PLATFORM-SCOPED: there is no merchantid on the envelope, and tenantid is the platform tenant. Health is measured per (gateway, operation) and never per merchant, because per-merchant samples are too sparse to be statistically meaningful.

errorRate.description: Error rate over the evaluation window, as a fraction.

sampleCount.description: Below 20 the transition to DEGRADED is not taken at all. Carried so consumers can judge confidence rather than reacting to a two-sample blip.

windowSeconds.description: Length of the sliding evaluation window. 30 by default.

cooldownSeconds.description: Present while UNHEALTHY. Doubles per failed probe, capped at 300.

region.description: Health is measured per region. A consumer in another region MUST NOT act on it - a gateway degraded in eu-central-1 may be perfectly healthy from us-east-1, and shifting traffic on the wrong signal turns one region's incident into two.

healthState.description: HEALTHY -> DEGRADED above 5% errors over 30 s with at least 20 samples. DEGRADED -> UNHEALTHY above 25% errors or p99 over 5 s, opening the circuit. UNHEALTHY -> PROBING after cool-down. PROBING -> HEALTHY after 3 consecutive successes, or back to UNHEALTHY on any failure. DEGRADED never transitions straight to PROBING.

x-envelope-notes: No merchantid - this event is platform-scoped. tenantid is set to the platform tenant.
